messages:
Maya: Quick kickoff for a community-focused tiny-refapp + microbenchmark launch. Goal: 300 dev signups & 80 demo requests in week 1. Keep everything low-friction and reproducible.
Arjun: 👍 timeline suggestion: repo live Wed -> short tutorial Thu -> 30-min live workshop Tue next week. Two social pushes (announce + reminder).
Priya: For messaging let's try a split test: variant A = "cost-first" (hard numbers up front). Variant B = "playbook-first" (show a quick dev workflow hook). We'll measure CTR + signup conversion.
Karl: Bench narrative (3 bullets) for landing + slides: 1) baseline: typical small-app inference costs are noisy and >$X per 1k tokens. 2) levers: quantization + batching + KV prefix caching can lower cost and stabilize latency. 3) result: reproducible harness shows median per-invocation cost down ~60% vs baseline with our default dataset. Keep the claim conservative and show CI.
Maya: Good. Hero stat for assets: "Median token cost reduced ~60% on conversational microbench". Use range + CI: "~45-70% depending on prompt length"
Arjun: Routing + lead capture plan: HubSpot list = "OSS_TinyRefapp_Webinar". Hidden fields: repo_action, utm_variant, lead_tier. HubSpot props to set: lead_tier (small/mid/enterprise), region, product_interest.
Priya: CRM rules: if company_size >= 1000 -> hubspot owner = enterprise-sdr; if region = APAC -> assign apac-sdr; if repo_action in (star,fork,issue) -> post a Slack alert to #sdr-inbound with payload.
Karl: Quick webhook payload we can fire from the repo CI on star/fork events (example in message):
```json
{"event":"github_refapp_event","type":"star|fork|issue","repo":"tiny-refapp","utm_variant":"B"}
```
Maya: devrel-bot: can you seed the repo with a bench harness and a demo dataset?
devrel-bot: seeded: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tiny-refapp. Includes bench.sh, sample prompts, and GH actions to run a quick smoke benchmark.
Priya: We'll build a 3-email nurture series: Day0 (welcome + repo quickstart), Day2 (bench howto + one-click run), Day5 (case study + invite to deeper demo). Add a post-webinar follow-up with recording + quick survey.
Arjun: Ads & social: run X and LinkedIn. Two creative buckets: metric-led vs dev-playbook. Landing uses utm_variant=a|b. A/B on creative + headline only.
Karl: For post-launch qualification: if a user runs bench.sh and posts results (CI artifact or GH issue) -> mark lead_tier = "engaged" and create task for AE to review. Also attach raw bench output to HubSpot record.
Maya: UX ask: registration form minimal fields: name, work email, company, role, allow_marketing (checkbox). Hidden: utm_variant, repo_action. Keep it single-step.
Priya: Also add a 1-click "run benchmark in cloud" button for folks who don't want local setup (calls a lightweight sandbox job, rate-limited). Track that event as sandbox_run in HubSpot.
Arjun: Slide + webinar plan: 20 slides max, 8-min demo, 10-min Q&A, live run of bench.sh showing RPS + cost estimate. Karl, you'll drive the demo?
Karl: yep. need one eng volunteer to monitor infra and answer deeper questions. @Henry from infra maybe?
Maya: Henry ok to help. Also we should prepare an FAQ doc with expected questions: accuracy tradeoffs, latency, recommended models, and how to reproduce numbers.
Priya: Post-webinar survey quick fields: biggest pain (latency|cost|quality), likelihood to try refapp (1-5), interest in enterprise demo (yes/no). Results map to HubSpot properties.
devrel-bot: CI note: bench smoke must finish <5 minutes and produce JSON summarizing rps, median_latency_ms, token_cost_usd. Example artifact name: bench_summary.json
Maya: final launch checklist (short): repo + README, bench harness + CI, 2 social creatives, registration page, HubSpot wiring + webhooks, slides + demo script, post-webinar assets. Owners: Arjun (landing + socials), Priya (HubSpot + nurture), Karl (bench + demo), Maya (overall).
Arjun: I'll draft two headline variants and the landing copy by Tue EOD.
Priya: I'll wire HubSpot and the webhook by Wed morning and set routing rules.
Karl: bench harness PR by Wed EOD.
Maya: Great. Callout: keep claims conservative and include reproduction steps so community can validate. Ping me if any blocker. :rocket:
